handback.t:
ecosystem-scout report. Full copy: C:[REDACTED:high_entropy].md. A short note is posted on BUS.md.

NAME SEARCH
- "gen ai superstream": no match. I read 1,732 plugin.json files under plugins/synced, cache and marketplaces, plus the 315-entry catalog cache. No Superstream plugin exists.
- Closest candidates: genai-tracing, otel-genai-instrumentation and dt-obs-genai (OTel GenAI tracing, which is not streaming), and streaming-skills-plugin (Confluent Kafka/Flink).
- "rGi xAI": no match. "xAI" appears only in the Diffbot and MosoFin xAI-marketplace listings. datarobot-agent-skills has a model-explainability skill if "xAI" meant explainable AI.
- The Obsidian "Top 20 Agents" and "Hive Mind" notes only list the lean fr-* agents and the ruflo nested-queen agents.

RANKED IMPROVEMENTS
All sources are MIT, so code copying is allowed with attribution. I recommend reimplementing, not porting. Nothing third-party was run. ruflo CLI dir = C:[REDACTED:high_entropy]@claude-flow/cli/dist/src.

1. Bounded turn-level credit (@metaharness/turn-credit, node_modules/@metaharness/turn-credit/README.md).
   - Adds: belief B_k = sigmoid(logit(B0) + decayed evidence), turned into a per-turn multiplier in [1-λb, 1+λb] that never flips the outcome's sign.
   - Target: memory credit and mesh reward. Port cost: low, about 60 lines.
   - Gate hypothesis: credit-weighted memory retrieval beats the flat outcome credit on hit@k in a planted-harmful-memory sim, paired t-CI excludes 0, seeds 1-30 tuned, 31-60 held out, 61-90 confirm, and no B1 battery regression.
   - Caveat: the package's own proxy mode is ordinal only.
2. Alpha-spending e-process gate (services/flywheel-sequential-evidence.js).
   - Adds: a betting e-process per candidate, with alpha_k = alpha·6/(π²k²) across the adaptive stream. The file cites 30-42% false-commit rates for greedy accept-if-improved loops.
   - Target: the hive gate and LLM promotion. Port cost: low.
   - Gate hypothesis: over 1,000 null simulations, family-wise false promotion stays at or below alpha, and real promotions still occur.
   - Overlap: scout-latent R5 (e-process) and the LatentMesh betting e-process. It is the same idea in a more usable form.
3. Tiered label provenance (services/distill-oracle.js).
   - Adds: oracle:test-exec > judge > proxy:structural. Proxy-tier items are never promoted.
   - Target: ingest/judge. Port cost: low, schema fields only.
   - Gate hypothesis: SFT built from oracle+judge rows beats SFT built from all rows on held-out judge score, paired over at least 30 seeds.
4. SFT guards (@metaharness/weight-eft README):
   - Contamination guard: train and eval stay disjoint.
   - Reward-hack filter: drop successes that read gold or test paths.
   - Long-context filter.
   - Target: LLM SFT and ingest. Port cost: low-medium.
   - Gate hypothesis: the guarded set has a lower held-out gap, with no held-out loss.
   - Overlap: ingestor already splits held-out by later sessions, but has no reward-hack filter.
5. $0 structural pre-judge (ruvector/output-verifier.js): empty, refusal, truncation, delimiter balance, repetition, TS/JSON parse.
   - Target: judge and ingest. Port cost: low.
   - Gate hypothesis: it cuts local-judge calls by X% while keeping at least 95% agreement with the full judge. It is not a quality judgment.
6. Self-supervised retrieval eval plus human anchor (services/harness-corpus-harvester.js): query = body keywords with the title words withheld, plus a non-regression anchor set.
   - Target: memory. Port cost: low.
   - Gate hypothesis: it ranks retrieval configs the same as the B1 battery (Spearman at least 0.8), at lower cost.
7. Isotonic (PAV) calibration of router scores (ruvector/router-calibrator.js, about 25 lines). The file documents a 0.45 gap at the low end of its router's scores.
   - Target: router and the OOD/abstain threshold. Port cost: very low.
   - Gate hypothesis: calibrated scores lower the wrong-local-answer rate at equal forward rate on replayed transcripts.
   - Overlap: partly rejected. Cartographer's "kNN abstain on vote confidence (B17)" is rejected, and the OOD floor smin .4 is already kept. Test calibration on the floor only.
8. Corroboration-gated promotion plus incremental cursors (services/memory-distillation.js, services/distill-tuning.js).
   - Adds: promote a pattern only when uses ≥ N near-duplicates agree. A run is held out by an 80/20 split of the store (rowid order) and the winner is scored once.
   - Target: memory and ingest. Port cost: low.
   - Gate hypothesis: promoted memories show a higher retrieval-to-success lift than unpromoted ones.
   - Overlap: R42 rejected usage-only forgetting. This promotes on agreement, not usage, so it is a different mechanism.
9. Discriminative keyword scoring (services/learned-routing.js): within-agent support × cross-agent rarity × outcome quality.
   - Target: router features for unseen wording. Port cost: low.
   - Overlap: B20 (learned keyword map from the journal) was rejected at -.065..-.22. Treat this as likely to repeat that negative unless it is only an additive prior.
10. learned-behavior plugin (MIT, 5206dc69-…/learning.py): SQLite lessons, auto-promoted when they keep proving themselves and decayed when stale, with no LLM. Memory credit. Overlaps the existing ledger (R95) and the RD-LOG tiered forgetting lessons. Idea only.
11. frugal plugin (MIT): deterministic → haiku → sonnet → main → fable, escalating only on verified failure. Front-end. Cheap to try, but R88 found ~0 savings on delegated work.

ALREADY TRIED OR REJECTED (do not repeat)
- ruflo SONA (sona-optimizer.js) is a keyword-to-agent confidence table (+0.1 on success, -0.15 on failure, 0.01/day decay). The hive tried SONA ports and kept nothing (g19a/g19b).
- ruflo EWC++ (ewc-consolidation.js): its F_i is squared embedding magnitude, not Fisher information. The file says so itself.
- model-router.js Thompson with priorDecay: router-trainer's discounted Beta-TS is a negative. The tempered-width LinUCB win is still the best.
- q-learning-router.js (720 lines) and MLP/NN routers: rejected as h22/g12.
- ruflo MoE exists only as an attention mode, and the pheromone/APSC module is an EMA suspension scheduler for agents, not a learner. Neither is worth porting.
- @metaharness/router is out of distribution on our tasks (queen finding).

NOT FOUND: no gen-ai-superstream or rGi-xAI plugin, and no LLM-judge calibration code beyond deepeval/giskard docs, which I did not read.
